canonicalFindings.title: Value-blind nudge gate: count>=nudgeSize pays the entire pot regardless of value paid (incomplete fix of prior H-01)
canonicalFindings.rootCause: The nudge gate is purely count-based (count >= nudgeSize) and transfers the full nudgePaymentToken balance; it never compares payout to value actually paid. story-014 removed the caller's CHOICE of minter/dispatcher/token but added no intrinsic price>0 / value-vs-payout check, so the value-blindness survives.
subVectors: (a) Owner-pinned dispatcher at config.price==0 (a documented SUPPORTED state) -> attacker clears gate for ~zero token cost and drains the full pot. Permissionless given the price==0 pin.
(b) Over-funded pot at non-zero price (pot > nudgeSize*price) -> independent owner knobs; whenever pot exceeds nudgeSize*price the drain is permissionlessly profitable even at non-zero price.
canonicalFindings.impact: Attacker drains the entire externally-funded nudge pot to a caller-chosen recipient for at-or-near-zero cost, repeatable as the pot refills.
canonicalFindings.ledgerNote: PARTIALLY-FIXED. Caller-choice half FIXED by story-014; value-blind half NOT fixed. If the mainnet-pinned dispatcher price was 0, this is effectively a REGRESSION of H-01 via owner config. Sub-vectors (a) and (b) share one root cause and one fix (bind payout to verified spend), so they are a SINGLE finding.

canonicalFindings.title: MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot
mergedSourceIds: ECON-002 (mislabeled ECON-003 in task brief; this is the MEV front-run finding)
canonicalFindings.rootCause: Full-balance, winner-take-all payout + permissionless entry + caller-chosen recipient. The first qualifying caller in a block takes the whole pot.
canonicalFindings.impact: A searcher copies an honest qualifying batchMint (recipient=searcher) and front-runs with higher priority fee, scooping the pot; the honest minter still pays mint cost + gas and receives no nudge (sees nudgeAmount==0).
canonicalFindings.distinctFrom: DEDUP-001: different root cause (mechanism design / mempool race, NOT pot-funding misconfig) and different impact (value-theft from an honest caller via MEV). No owner misconfig required. Kept separate; separate mitigation surface.

canonicalFindings.title: batchMint lacks nonReentrant; ERC1155 onERC1155Received callback re-enters mid-loop
canonicalFindings.line: 238-257 (no guard; callback fires per loop iteration before forceApprove(0) at 242 and nudge payout at 246)
canonicalFindings.rootCause: BatchNFTMinter does not inherit ReentrancyGuard (unlike sibling NFTStaker). ERC1155 _mint invokes onERC1155Received on the caller-chosen recipient mid-loop while max approval is live, paymentAmount is held, and the nudge pot is intact.
canonicalFindings.impact: Defensive gap only. Adjudicated NOT-EXPLOITABLE for third-party fund loss on current code: full-balance payout is idempotent to zero, held paymentAmount is the attacker's own per-call budget, max approval is bounded to the contract's own balance, and NFTStaker has independent guarded storage. Becomes HIGH if the payout is changed to fixed-amount or a per-caller balance is retained.
canonicalFindings.ledgerNote: PATTERN-004 (caller-controlled-target) and ECON-004 (reentrancy economic angle) are absorbed here: PATTERN-004's dangerous arbitrary-target vector is closed by story-014; its residual recipient-as-callback surface IS the mechanism of this finding. ECON-004 confirms no extra pot leak for a standard token.

canonicalFindings.title: Uncapped count loop in batchMint
canonicalFindings.rootCause: for (uint256 i; i < count; ++i) with count a fully caller-supplied uint256 and no MAX_COUNT ceiling; each iteration is an external mint call.
canonicalFindings.impact: Large count exceeds the block gas limit (self-DoS / failed tx for the caller). Per-iteration cost is the intended economic friction for the nudge gate, so impact is bounded to gas-griefing the caller's own tx.

canonicalFindings.title: Nudge-token equality guard reverts even when nudge is size-disabled
mergedSourceIds: (carried forward from ledger; confirmed still present at HEAD 031ffda)
canonicalFindings.rootCause: The up-front guard reverts whenever nudgePaymentToken != 0 && == paymentToken, BEFORE the nudgeSize check at line 245-246. So even when the nudge is disabled via nudgeSize == 0 (no payout would occur), a configured-but-equal nudge token bricks every batchMint.
canonicalFindings.codeConfirmation: Verified against lib/phoenix-nft-staking/src/BatchNFTMinter.sol:230-233. Guard is unconditional on nudgeSize; the nudgeSize gate is a separate later check at 245-246. Still present at HEAD.
canonicalFindings.impact: QA/usability nit: batchMint reverts for a config (nudge token == payment token) that is harmless when nudgeSize==0.
canonicalFindings.ledgerNote: CARRIED FORWARD. Confirmed unchanged at current HEAD.

dropped.reason: NOT-EXPLOITABLE inert. CODE-002 traced NFTMinterV2._executeMint: it always returns true and reverts on every failure path, so the ignored return value cannot advance the count gate past a silently-failed mint. The value-relevant nudge-integrity concern from SAST-003 is folded into DEDUP-001; the bare unchecked-return is dropped.
By-design. configs() partial destructure (address dispatcher,,,) is intentional; only dispatcher/primeToken are needed here. No impact.
Noise. Loop induction variable default-zero init is correct and intentional; Aderyn uninitialized-local false positive.

By-design. address(0) is the documented disable sentinel for setNudgePaymentToken/setPauser/setTokenMinter; owner-only with documented zero==disable semantics. Filtered per known-issues (missing zero-address checks without fund loss).
Mitigated context contract. NFTStaker masterchef reentrancy is guarded by OZ nonReentrant on every entrypoint; no live path. NFTStaker is context, not focus.
Benign. _syncBudget calls owner-configured (trusted) dispatcherHook.pull(); all callers nonReentrant. Listed for completeness only.
Absorbed into DEDUP-003. Arbitrary-target vector closed by story-014; residual recipient-as-callback surface is the mechanism of the reentrancy finding.

NOT a leak / by-design. nudge!=payment guard structurally excludes cross-token sweep gaming; over-supply refunded, under-supply reverts atomically; sub-DUST_THRESHOLD residue is intentionally donated. Informational, no security impact.
Absorbed into DEDUP-003. No extra pot leak for a standard token; pot read as balanceOf is already drained on first transfer.
